preflight_failures.failure: The first memory-registry probe used the parent memory directory instead of the actual memories/MEMORY.md registry and found no file.
preflight_failures.recovery: Resolved the documented memories/MEMORY.md literal path and performed one bounded keyword pass.

preflight_failures.failure: The first read-only skill inventory wrapper piped directly from a foreach block and PowerShell rejected the empty pipeline element before reading a skill.
preflight_failures.recovery: Materialized the bounded inventory rows before projecting them.

preflight_failures.failure: A combined multi-skill read exceeded its bounded output and truncated before every selected skill reached literal EOF.
preflight_failures.recovery: Read each required skill separately in bounded complete projections.

preflight_failures.failure: The first broad handoff line window truncated because a small number of source lines were exceptionally long.
preflight_failures.recovery: Used smaller contiguous windows and verified the committed EOF sentinel.

preflight_failures.failure: The first compact Caelen JSON projection retained inherited arrays and exceeded its output budget.
preflight_failures.recovery: Selected only exact scalar counts and named keys.

preflight_failures.failure: A second compact source projection still emitted nested portfolio arrays and truncated.
preflight_failures.recovery: Used targeted scalar-only projections and independent recursive JSON parsing.

preflight_failures.failure: The first raw v15 workflow display omitted middle assignments and could not prove sequence continuity.
preflight_failures.recovery: Parsed the complete JSON locally and checked all 210 contiguous ordinals.

preflight_failures.failure: A mixed PowerShell and cmd temporary-file manifest probe was rejected by host policy before execution.
preflight_failures.recovery: Used a read-only Node Git-blob stream and PowerShell-native cleanup-free scalar probes.

preflight_failures.failure: The local tracking ref observed earlier was absent when rechecked even though the live remote still advertised the exact final.
preflight_failures.recovery: Fetched only the named Caelen source branch into its matching remote-tracking ref.

preflight_failures.failure: An ancestry query ran before the missing source object was refetched and returned an ambiguous-revision failure.
preflight_failures.recovery: Repeated the bounded ancestry query only after the exact source fetch exited zero.

preflight_failures.failure: The first sparse no-checkout worktree projection retained an empty index, so Git status presented inherited paths as staged deletions before any commit.
preflight_failures.recovery: Populated the exact source index with git read-tree -mu HEAD; only the Orin owner directory remained untracked and no inherited blob changed.

preflight_failures.failure: The first planning serialization used pretty JSON and measured 193346 whitespace-delimited words, above the 100000-word document ceiling.
preflight_failures.recovery: Preserved the same parsed plan semantics in deterministic compact JSON, recorded the failed precommit projection, and rebuilt the planning manifest.
